## Installation

```bash
bun add @solana-programs/mpl-core @solana/kit
```

Client for the [Metaplex Core](https://github.com/metaplex-foundation/mpl-core) program.

## Usage

```typescript
import { fetchAssetV1 } from "@solana-programs/mpl-core";
```
